newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH C.BANK SETS 26WK T-BILL AUCTION AT 12.75 PCT.
newsitem.headline: CZECH C.BANK SETS 26WK T-BILL AUCTION AT 12.75 PCT.

text.p: The Czech Nation Bank (CNB) on Tuesday set a Dutch auction offering 5.3 billion crowns in 26-week finance ministry treasury bills on Wednesday with maximum gross yield on bids set at 12.75 percent.
The deadline for bids to be submitted to the CNB has been set at 1200 local time (1100 gmt), the central bank said.
Average yield in the last Dutch auction of 26-week Czech t-bills on December 11, was 11.41 percent, down from 12.37 percent on August 28.
The December auction offered 13 billion crowns in the 26-week paper and was oversubscribed by 11.31 billion crowns.
